verdict.rationale: treg ships an official CLI with a one-line installer (`curl -fsSL https://treg.to/install.sh | sh`). Documented, agent-oriented commands include `treg review`, `treg upload clis`, `treg shell`, `treg tool ls`, `treg health` and `treg feedback submit`, it is covered in the tutorial, and it sits alongside llms.txt so agents can be pointed at it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as described, beyond vendor docs and the repo README.
